text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come tomorrow morning, we'll be leaving this camp behind and returning to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer—are you good at dancing?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. At the end of Princess Fighter, the legendary princess dances with the prince under a starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And that's when the prince realizes that he was Legendary Trainer all along.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And that's when the prince realizes that he was Legendary Trainer all along.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So, would you like to dance for one song? We can even do a folk dance if you prefer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Well, even if you refuse, I think we both know who the legendary trainer is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, summer comes to a close.
